paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apply for the position of part-time Community Activities Assistant. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to an online study workshop while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to apply for the position of [vị trí ứng tuyển]. I am interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to contribute to [sự kiện / hoạt động] while developing my skills in a practical working environment.

paragraphs.text: I have experience in welcoming participants and preparing materials for activities at my college. I am willing to learn and would take care to follow the instructions given by my supervisor.
